sourceName: User-uploaded California series; source attribution is not independently verified

recordSchema.socCode: Six-digit SOC code in NN-NNNN format.
recordSchema.areaName: Geographic name represented by the point series.
recordSchema.areaType: Normalized geography label. The uploaded California rows used two spellings of statewide area type.
recordSchema.sourceUrl: null when the uploaded file does not include a verifiable direct source URL.
recordSchema.publicationDate: null when the uploaded file does not provide a verified release date.
recordSchema.retrievedAt: Timestamp when this local snapshot was assembled.
recordSchema.recordStatus: verified only after source comparison; user-supplied-unverified when origin or values have not been independently checked.
recordSchema.reportedQuarter: Quarter label exactly as shown in the uploaded CSV.
recordSchema.missingYears: Years without observations; the chart leaves visible breaks for these years.

points.year: integer year as supplied by the uploaded CSV
points.employment: non-negative integer from the CSV's Number of Employed field

records.sourceName: California government open-data mirror (attributed by uploader; not independently verified)
